def find_permutations(k, arr):
    n = 2 ** k
    if all(x == 0 for x in arr):
        print("Shi")
        print(" ".join(map(str, range(n))))
        print(" ".join(map(str, range(n))))
        return

        for q in range(n):
            if all((p ^ q) == arr[i] for i in range(n)):

                print(" ".join(map(str, [p ^ i for i in range(n)])))
                print(" ".join(map(str, [q ^ i for i in range(n)])))
                return
    print("Fou")
